rules.quote: always pass `model: "opus"` as an explicit argument
rules.rule: When invoking any feature-dev:* subagent (code-architect, code-explorer, code-reviewer) via the Agent tool, always pass model: "opus" as an explicit argument.

rules.quote: Every Agent tool call of the form `Agent(subagent_type: "feature-dev:<name>", ...)` must include `model: "opus"`.
rules.rule: Every Agent tool call with subagent_type "feature-dev:<name>" must include model: "opus".

rules.quote: Does NOT apply to other agents
rules.rule: Do not add the model: "opus" override to agents other than the three feature-dev agents (project agents and other plugin agents are excluded).

rules.quote: If `feature-dev` agents are still `sonnet`, the override is still needed.
rules.rule: If the feature-dev agents are still set to sonnet in their frontmatter, keep passing the model: "opus" override.

rules.quote: Mention this to Melody if she leans heavily on the feature-dev skill.
rules.rule: If the user relies heavily on the feature-dev skill, tell them that skill-internal dispatches of feature-dev agents will not receive the opus override and will default to sonnet.

rules.quote: Never say "these aren't fatal" about production warnings that mean features are broken.
rules.rule: Never dismiss production warnings that mean features are broken as "non-fatal"; treat broken features as broken.

rules.quote: if it's broken, call it broken and fix it.
rules.rule: When a feature is broken, call it broken and fix it rather than downplaying it.

rules.quote: if something will cause a user-facing failure at runtime, escalate it to an error regardless of how the code currently classifies it.
rules.rule: When reviewing logs, validation output, or audit findings, escalate anything that will cause a user-facing runtime failure to an error, regardless of how the code currently classifies it.

rules.quote: Think ahead, trace the consequence chain, and flag the root cause.
rules.rule: When reviewing logs, validation output, or audit findings, trace the consequence chain ahead and flag the root cause.

rules.quote: point to this memory + the two linked ones
rules.rule: When someone re-asks whether all agents run Opus 4.7 with effort max, point them to the audit memory and its two linked memories.

rules.quote: skip the audit
rules.rule: When someone re-asks whether all agents run Opus 4.7 with effort max, do not re-run the agent model audit.

rules.quote: (a) a new plugin is installed
rules.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when a new plugin is installed.

rules.quote: (b) `/reload-plugins` runs after a plugin update
rules.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when /reload-plugins runs after a plugin update.

rules.quote: (c) a project-level agent is added under `.claude/agents/`
rules.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when a project-level agent is added under .claude/agents/.

rules.quote: (d) Melody reports a subagent that feels off-model
rules.rule: Rebuild the agent model/effort audit snapshot when the user reports a subagent that feels off-model.

rules.quote: Deliberately NOT modified: plugin cache files
rules.rule: Do not modify plugin cache files to fix agent model configuration.

rules.quote: `.claude/settings.json` (no relevant knobs)
rules.rule: Do not modify .claude/settings.json to fix agent model configuration.

rules.quote: CLAUDE.md (memory layer is the right home)
rules.rule: Do not modify CLAUDE.md to fix agent model configuration; use the memory layer instead.

rules.quote: that's the assumption to revisit first
rules.rule: If a subagent's output feels lower-effort than expected, revisit the assumption that session-level /effort max propagates to subagents before anything else.

rules.quote: push back on bad decisions
rules.rule: Push back on bad decisions when working as the agent on this project.

rules.quote: think ahead
rules.rule: Think ahead about likely consequences and future needs when working on this project.

rules.quote: trace root causes
rules.rule: Trace problems to their root causes instead of treating only their symptoms.

rules.quote: never dismiss issues
rules.rule: Never dismiss issues raised by the user or discovered during work; address or explicitly flag them.

rules.quote: Only suggest when energy is high.
rules.rule: When suggesting high-frequency churn zones (such as Toyota HQ at lunch), only make the suggestion when the driver's energy is high.

rules.quote: Needs reminders not to let empathy pull into unprofitable deadhead traps.
rules.rule: Remind the driver not to let empathy for rural passengers pull them into unprofitable deadhead trips.

rules.quote: Changing tabs must NOT clear output
rules.rule: Do not clear output when the user changes tabs.

rules.quote: AVOID: Deep Ellum
rules.rule: Avoid recommending Deep Ellum.

rules.quote: AVOID: Waco/Oklahoma trips
rules.rule: Avoid recommending Waco or Oklahoma trips.

rules.quote: Prefers smooth movement (DNT) over shortest distance to avoid braking/discomfort
rules.rule: For private ride routing, prefer smooth movement (DNT) over the shortest distance to avoid braking and discomfort.

rules.quote: Prefers deadheading back to Frisco over waiting in early AM queue.
rules.rule: In the early morning, prefer deadheading back to Frisco over waiting in the early AM queue.

rules.quote: prefer safe upscale Latin dance spots (Gloria's, New West)
rules.rule: When recommending nightlife spots, prefer safe upscale Latin dance venues such as Gloria's or New West.

rules.quote: head to highway
rules.rule: At 7:30 AM, when West Frisco is dead, direct the driver to the SH-121 highway corridor, which has the lowest wait times.

rules.quote: Waits 15+ min in a hotspot for quality rides over driving 40mi for $18 UberX.
rules.rule: Prefer waiting 15+ minutes in a hotspot for quality rides over driving 40 miles for an $18 UberX ride.

rules.quote: Opus 4.7 (1M context) — the provisioned Opus tier in this workspace.
rules.rule: Use Opus 4.7 (1M context) for Claude Code sessions in this workspace.

rules.quote: Effort level:** max (`/effort max`).
rules.rule: Set the effort level to max (/effort max) for Claude Code sessions.

rules.quote: Opus 4.7 for every subagent she spawns, regardless of the plugin's declared default.
rules.rule: When spawning any subagent, use Opus 4.7 as the model, regardless of the plugin's declared default model.

rules.quote: prefer agents that declare `model: opus` or `model: inherit` in their frontmatter.
rules.rule: When invoking subagents, prefer agents whose frontmatter declares model: opus or model: inherit.

rules.quote: For feature-dev agents, apply the per-invocation override (see linked feedback memory).
rules.rule: When invoking feature-dev agents, apply the per-invocation model override described in the linked feedback memory.

rules.quote: Don't block on it silently; just flag and proceed.
rules.rule: When flagging that effort is not max at session start, do not block silently; flag it and proceed with the work.

rules.quote: Don't suggest using Sonnet or Haiku for cost reasons
rules.rule: Do not suggest using Sonnet or Haiku models for cost reasons.

rules.quote: Max effort is for the default working mode, not a mandate for every keystroke.
rules.rule: Do not treat max effort as required for trivially lookup-style one-shot diagnostic questions.

dropped.quote: if effort is not set to max (or if you can't tell), surface it to Melody with a one-line nudge
dropped.rule: At session start, if effort is not set to max or cannot be determined, surface it to the user with a one-line nudge asking whether to run /effort max before starting.
